# Mencius — plan

Easy-win reserve, set up 2026-11-20 at the owner's request ("easy wins in the pipelines so we can jump
to these when there are problems with the most complex texts"). 34 parts, ~35,400 characters; status
in `parts.json`. Same edition, machinery and voice as the Analects (completed 2026-11). No pilot gate:
the owner chose the work and the machinery is proven; the first part is reviewed like any other.

The parts (cite, characters) are listed in `parts.json`; regenerate with `python3 archive_mencius.py`.
